Method of Attack: Bypassing file-sharing permissions and escaping outside the share root directory via failure to reset cache tracking directory changes
Exploitation requires 'wide links' option enabled and either 'allow insecure wide links' set to yes or 'unix extension' set to no
Impacted Systems: Samba software versions 4.9.0 to before 4.9.13 and 4.10.8
Attack Vector: Misconfiguration of Samba settings ('wide links', 'allow insecure wide links', 'unix extension') allowing SMB requests to operate in wrong directory
